Financial pressure (2 of 4): two pressure flags (going concern, covenant problems, incentive pay tied to revenue/EPS, capital raise) give management motive to manage earnings.
Transaction complexity (2 of 8): a modest level of complex areas, such as over-time revenue, related parties, acquisitions or concentration, gives some opportunity for judgmental misstatement.
Mitigating: no investigations or litigation (0 of 3) and no management turnover (0 of 2). With 9 flags in total and specific item identities withheld, the risk is elevated but not severe.
